say:1:1121201001:1.text: Great! I was just starting to worry and then I looked up and saw you coming!
say:1:1121201001:1.source_cn: 太好了！我正发愁，一抬头就看见你走了过来！
say:1:1121201001:1.male: Great! I was just starting to worry and then I looked up and saw you coming!
say:1:1121201001:1.female: Great! I was just starting to worry and then I looked up and saw you coming!

say:2:1121201002:0.text: Two Wilders of the Dark Forest came to visit.
say:2:1121201002:0.source_cn: 是这样，有两位绿裔的人从薄暮丛林而来，目的是交流参观。
say:2:1121201002:0.male: Two Wilders of the Dark Forest came to visit.
say:2:1121201002:0.female: Two Wilders of the Dark Forest came to visit.

say:3:1121201003:0.text: One of them has ears akin to a rabbit's—I think you know them.
say:3:1121201003:0.source_cn: 其中一位有着兔子般的耳朵，你一定认识。
say:3:1121201003:0.male: One of them has ears akin to a rabbit's—I think you know them.

say:5:1121201004:1.source_cn: 没错，正是那位莱卡小姐。

say:6:1121201006:0.text: I invited them to the Traveler's Light. Since we seldom get visitors in Holistone, I ought to share the local delicacies.
say:6:1121201006:0.source_cn: 我将她们请去了旅人灯火，难得来一趟圣石镇，总要尝尝当地...

say:7:1121201007:0.text: But Joseline is not familiar with the unique customs of the Wilders and is afraid of unintentionally offending esteemed guests. As you know, she's a mindful hostess.
say:7:1121201007:0.source_cn: 但乔思琳女士不懂绿裔的特殊习俗，怕一不小心冒犯了贵客。...
say:7:1121201007:0.male: But Joseline is not familiar with the unique customs of the Wilders and is afraid of unintentionally offending esteemed guests. As you know, she's a mindful hostess.
say:7:1121201007:0.female: But Joseline is not familiar with the unique customs of the Wilders and is afraid of unintentionally offending esteemed guests. As you know, she's a mindful hostess.

say:8:1121201008:0.source_cn: 所以我需要找一个对绿裔熟悉的人，原本是打算去冬青学会请...

say:10:1121201009:0.text: Ha, she spoke of you, actually. I'm sure she'll be happily surprised when she sees you.
say:10:1121201009:0.source_cn: 哈哈，其实莱卡小姐也念叨着你，见到你，她肯定会大吃一惊的。
say:10:1121201009:0.male: Ha, she spoke of you, actually. I'm sure she'll be happily surprised when she sees you.
say:10:1121201009:0.female: Ha, she spoke of you, actually. I'm sure she'll be happily surprised when she sees you.

say:11:1121201012:0.text: Anyways, I'm relieved to have you along.
say:11:1121201012:0.source_cn: 总之，有你同行我就放心了。
say:11:1121201012:0.male: Anyways, I'm relieved to have you along.
say:11:1121201012:0.female: Anyways, I'm relieved to have you along.

say:12:1121201013:0.text: We can't keep our honored guests waiting, so let's head to the Traveler's Light before it gets too late.
say:12:1121201013:0.source_cn: 不能让贵客久等，事不宜迟，我们一起去旅人灯火吧。

choice:9:0:1.text: It'd be nice to see Lyca.
choice:9:0:1.male: It'd be nice to see Lyca.
choice:9:0:1.female: It'd be nice to see Lyca.

say:14:1121201010:1.text: Well, if there's anyone in the Heroic Order who knows the Wilders best, it's definitely him. After all, he's been to the Dark Forest with you.
say:14:1121201010:1.source_cn: 是啊，要说骑士团里有谁最了解绿裔，肯定是那小子，毕竟他...

say:15:1121201011:0.text: But he's out on an errand and won't return for some time.
say:15:1121201011:0.source_cn: 但他出去办事了，一时半会儿回不来。

say:16:1121201005:1.source_cn: 是洛桑的姐姐——莱卡小姐。
